decisions.statement: Every slot is made from the slot list in one pass.
A slot that is no separator has the refresh command.
The readings are read from the file the service writes rather than taken here.
The strip draws again when that file is written and at no other time.
A file the service has not written leaves the strip as that strip is.
A section the file says nothing for is drawn as a reading that failed.
A click reads the file again rather than waiting to be told the file moved.
A section the file says nothing for keeps the labels that section last named.
A section with an empty legend keeps the labels that section last named.
The glyph row is read off the section the file has.
A drawing says which readings the file had nothing for.
Nothing here reads a stoplight or a figure.

definition: the strip of readings Alan keeps in view, drawn from one file and on a click
